page.summary: Locate the teammate whose state matters next, reach them for a useful heal or cooperative task, and avoid bringing chase to their work.

verdict.recommendation: Use team-location information to make a support handoff without spending the whole Trial searching for one teammate.
verdict.soloQ: A visible nearby teammate or injured aura can replace a missing location call; approach only when the heal, rescue or repair handoff is timely.
verdict.coordinatedSwf: Use voice positions first; keep a tracking slot only when the changing location or injury state still adds useful information.
verdict.mainWeakness: Team auras can duplicate coordinated calls, and following an injured player can waste time or lead the Killer to them.

options.whyItsHere: Shows nearby teammate auras so you can find a cooperative repair or avoid steering the Killer into their position.
Shows injured or dying teammates within range, making a timely heal or recovery approach possible without a voice call.
Lets injured teammates see your aura and speeds your healing of others; this broadcasts your support position rather than revealing every teammate to you.

opening: Choose whether the next useful teammate interaction is a nearby co-op task, a heal or a safe place for an injured teammate to find you. These perks answer different location questions.

rows.situation: Bond shows a nearby teammate working or moving through your route.
rows.action: Join a worthwhile cooperative objective or route away if you are bringing the Killer toward them.
rows.why: Bond is a nearby teammate-location read, not an injury or map-wide rescue signal.

rows.situation: Empathy reveals an injured or dying teammate within its range.
rows.action: Check whether reaching them changes recovery or healing now; if chase or hook pressure makes the approach unsafe, keep working and reassess later.
rows.why: The aura identifies a support opportunity, but travelling to every injured player can lose more tempo than the heal returns.

rows.situation: An injured teammate can see you through Empathic Connection and you can offer a safe heal.
rows.action: Hold a safe support position and heal them when they arrive; do not chase their unseen location or assume this perk reveals them to you.
rows.why: Its aura direction is from you to injured teammates; the healing bonus matters only during your heal of another Survivor.

rows.situation: The teammate is out of range, fully healed, already supported or has called a safe position.
rows.action: Stop searching and return to repair or the urgent rescue rather than spending a slot's value on a redundant meeting.
rows.why: I03 is a team-location layer, not a requirement to shadow teammates.

abortWhen: The visible teammate is already covered or the route to them is unsafe under current Killer pressure.
A voice call or completed heal makes further aura-chasing redundant.

weaknesses: The value is lower when teammates can call locations, and support travel can displace repair time.
commonMistakes: Treating Empathic Connection as if it reveals injured teammates to the perk owner.
Running toward every injury aura without checking whether a heal is safe or needed.
